strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill phaser-arcade-physics，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use for a Phaser platformer or top-down controller, or a sprite that ignores physics, onFloor() always false or bodies passing through walls.
Workflow: Enable the world with debug drawing on; Create bodies through the physics factory; Move dynamic bodies through the body; Register each `collider` and `overlap` once in `create`.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：phaser-core 用 gene_gdsk_phaser_core_v1，platformer 用 gene_gdsk_platformer_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
